resources.string: Role NOT held after request. Likely the Restricted Settings gate: App Info -> menu (3-dot) -> Allow restricted settings, then re-request this role.

Channel: ring_probe_v1 (HIGH, sound = DEFAULT_RINGTONE_URI indirection, vibration on).
Manual check: press the button below — a CallStyle incoming-call notification should ring with the current system tone.
End-to-end check: hold ROLE_DIALER first (section 1), then have another phone call this one.
1. Does it ring with the system tone?
2. Change Settings - Sound - Phone ringtone, call again. Did the tone FOLLOW?

Ensure contact \"XX Probe 5550100\" exists with number 555-0100, then run the probe.\nScope test: Settings - Apps - XX-Probe - Contacts -> set to limited (or remove), then press re-run and compare row counts.
Every line is ISO-timestamped and self-contained; paste verbatim into design.md section 4 [VERIFY] flags.
